executable.title: Simple Threshold Filter
executable.description: Binary threshold filter for 3D NIFTI images with signed short pixel type. Pixels within [lowThreshold, highThreshold] are set to insideValue, all other pixels outside this range are set to outsideValue. Based on itk::BinaryThresholdImageFilter. ECE:5490 HW04 - Md Shahin Ali (mali25)

parameters.label: Threshold Parameters
parameters.description: Parameters controlling the binary threshold operation

double.name: lowThreshold
double.description: Lower bound of the threshold range (inclusive). Pixels with intensity >= lowThreshold and <= highThreshold are set to insideValue.
double.label: Low Threshold

double.name: highThreshold
double.description: Upper bound of the threshold range (inclusive). Must be greater than or equal to lowThreshold. Pixels with intensity <= highThreshold and >= lowThreshold are set to insideValue.
double.label: High Threshold

double.name: outsideValue
double.description: Output intensity value assigned to pixels whose input intensity falls outside the range [lowThreshold, highThreshold].
double.label: Outside Value

double.name: insideValue
double.description: Output intensity value assigned to pixels whose input intensity falls within the range [lowThreshold, highThreshold].
double.label: Inside Value

image.name: inputVolume
image.label: Input Volume
image.description: Input 3D NIFTI volume with signed short pixel type. This volume will be thresholded using the specified low and high threshold values.

image.name: outputVolume
image.label: Output Volume
image.description: Output 3D NIFTI volume after binary thresholding. Same dimensions and pixel type as input.
